in_sanskrit.name: Adith
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Bright, Moon
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Adith एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Adith is the name of the moon god in Hindu mythology. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'aditya', meaning 'bright'. Adith is also referred to as Soma or Chandra, representing the giver of light, knowledge, and prosperity.
